description: Research collage around the tarmac meeting: Trump's 15 Apr 2018 Comey/Lynch tarmac tweet; Q drop No.283394; an anon reply 'Lynch offered a SC position if Hillary got through?'; Q drop No.283537 ('Build timeline. AS 187. HRC investigation pivot points. JC dismiss letter. #2. PS. WL comms. Q'); a second Q drop 'Coincidence? SC/LL deal drop. POTUS Tweet. Tarmac. Coming soon to a theater near you. Q'; the Wikipedia opening on Antonin Scalia (died February 13, 2016); and a Judicial Watch release saying the FBI located 30 pages of documents on the June 27, 2016 tarmac meeting between Lynch and Bill Clinton.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump. Comey throws AG Lynch under the bus! Why can't we all find out what happened on the tarmac in the back of the plane with Wild Bill and Lynch? Was she promised a Supreme Court seat, or AG, in order to lay off Hillary. No golf and grandkids talk (give us all a break)! 5:08 AM - 15 Apr 2018. 20,463 Retweets 75,773 Likes. Q !UW.yye1fxo 02/06/18 No.283394. Public interest [keep high]. U1 FBI informant. AWAN/DWS/Paki intel/MB. Tarmac meeting [SC/LL deal > AS 187]. Q. Anonymous 02/06/18 No.283468. Lynch offered a SC position if Hillary got through? Q !UW.yye1fxo 02/06/18 No.283537. Build timeline. AS 187. HRC investigation pivot points. JC dismiss letter. #2. PS. WL comms. Q. Coincidence? SC/LL deal drop. POTUS Tweet. Tarmac. Coming soon to a theater near you. Q. Antonin Gregory Scalia; March 11, 1936 - February 13, 2016, was an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court of the United States from 1986 until his death in 2016. Appointed to the Court by President Ronald Reagan in 1986, Scalia was described as the intellectual anchor for the originalist and textualist position in the Court's conservative wing. (Washington, DC) - Judicial Watch was informed yesterday by the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) that the FBI has located 30 pages of documents related to the June 27, 2016, tarmac meeting between former Attorney General Loretta Lynch and former President Bill Clinton, and proposes non-exempt material be produced no later than November 30, 2017 (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice (No. 1:16-cv-02046)).
flags: The graphic's implied Scalia connection is a claim; the Judicial Watch and Wikipedia text are factual quotes

description: iPhone photo from a high floor over a dense high-rise business district on an overcast day — glass towers, tree-lined blocks, a white domed pavilion below. Chinese bank and company signs are visible (including CITIC Bank), consistent with the Shenzhen Futian central business district. One of the location-proof photos Q attached in April 2018.

description: iPhone photo through a window: a massive dark slab-like building raised on huge diagonal struts with a red LED strip across its underside, an ornate carved stone monument with a flame-like sculpture in front, palm trees and an elevated roadway below — a monumental civic structure in a Chinese city, taken from the same vantage series as the Shenzhen skyline photo.

description: High-angle photo of two Chinese PLA Navy amphibious landing ships moored side by side at a pier on the Huangpu River near the Bund, Shanghai — hull numbers 916 and 981 painted on their helicopter decks and bow. Hull 981 is consistent with the Type 072A-class tank landing ship Emeishan; 916 with an earlier Type 072-series landing ship. Small civilian ferries pass behind. Filename: 'CH_Navy_Bund'.
